sourceBoundaries: Parallel explicitly documents ShapBot indexing, Shap-User retrieval and distinct signing directories; implementation currently adds declarations/roles only.
The checked DuckDuckBot page documents crawling and an IP feed, but supplies no signing promise or link to the retained claimed signing origin.
The inspected Meta page documents Meta-WebIndexer and its role; no signing promise found on that page.
A scoped search found no usable authoritative source for publisher-1. This is unavailable documentation, not evidence of maliciousness.
RFC 9421 section 2.2.6 requires the empty path to be represented as /. No verifier fallback was added.
